name: opencodex
author: Ryens
description: OpenCodex is a middleware layer for Codex Desktop. It lets you use a phone, tablet, or another computer to access and operate Codex on a target machine through a browser, making it suitable for continuous AI Coding in LAN or remote LAN environments.

scripts.typecheck:skeleton: tsc -p gateway/tsconfig.skeleton.json --noEmit && tsc -p web-shell/tsconfig.skeleton.json && tsc -p examples/plugin-v2-hello/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:skeleton: pnpm run typecheck:skeleton && pnpm run build:skeleton:node && pnpm run build:skeleton:browser && pnpm run check:skeleton-boundaries
scripts.build:gateway: pnpm run sync:version && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('gateway/dist', { force: true, recursive: true })" && pnpm run build:skeleton && tsc -p gateway/tsconfig.json && pnpm run check:version
scripts.launcher:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron .
scripts.launcher:pack:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.launcher:dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.launcher:pack:win: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --win --dir --x64
scripts.launcher:dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.launcher:pack:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --linux --dir --x64
scripts.launcher:dist:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm exec electron-builder --linux AppImage deb zip --x64
